home.description: Browse the courses and learn at your own pace. No sign-up required.

admin.noCourses: No courses yet. Create the first one.
admin.sectionsEmpty: This course has no sections yet.
admin.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete it? This cannot be undone.
admin.aiAssistedHint: A clear notice will be shown when starting the course.
admin.registrationOpenHint: If disabled, no one else can create accounts. The library stays public.
admin.newsEnabledHint: If disabled, the section simply will not appear.
admin.ownerNameHint: Shown in the footer. Leave empty to hide it.
admin.logoHint: If you upload a logo, it is shown instead of the name.
admin.placementHint: Choose where the page is linked.
admin.backupHint: Download a zip with the whole environment: database, media files and encryption key.
admin.restoreHint: Restoring replaces the ENTIRE current environment with the backup contents.
admin.restoreWarning: ⚠ This will replace the ENTIRE current environment (courses, users, progress, media and settings) with the backup contents. It cannot be undone. Continue?
admin.restoreDone: Backup restored. The environment is exactly as it was in the backup. Please sign in again.
admin.licenseHint: How this course may be reused (e.g. CC BY-SA 4.0). Optional.
admin.heroHint: Empty = default text in the visitor’s language.
admin.logoDarkHint: Optional. Shown instead of the header logo when the dark theme is active.
admin.invertLogo: Invert logo colors in dark theme

admin.logoFallbackHint: If empty, the header logo is used.
admin.postAuthorHint: Shown next to the publication date.
admin.deleteUserWarning: This permanently deletes the user, their progress, exam results and certificates.
admin.heroImageHint: Optional. Shown behind the home headline; without it a brand gradient is used.
admin.revokeWarning: This permanently deletes the certificate; its verification link will stop working.
admin.userDisplayNameHint: Shown on this user's certificates. Leave empty to use the identifier.
admin.noCategories: No categories yet. Courses can still use free-text categories.
admin.categoryImageHint: Shown on the home page card. Renaming relabels existing courses; deleting keeps their text category.
admin.categoryPickHint: Pick an existing category or type a new one.

exam.question: Question
exam.questionCountHint: Empty = all. With a pool of 100 questions and a value of 10, each attempt draws 10 at random.

First, fetch and read the full course text here: {url} — then help me study it: answer my questions, explain the lessons in other words, and quiz me to check my understanding. study.registerToKeep: Register to keep your progress and certificates across devices.

auth.registrationClosed: Registration is closed on this library. You can keep studying without an account.
